summary: Verified hero search form overflow fix on Landing page across 6 viewports (1920, 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 375). Form no longer overflows its parent (lg:col-span-5); Explore button, city select, and search input all fit inside the form. Regression: submitting form navigates to /listings?q=ocean correctly. No horizontal scrollbar at any tested breakpoint.

issues: Search input becomes very narrow (~43px visible width) because form width is 372px while select (133px) + button (113px) + gaps/padding consume most space. Still functional and not clipped, but placeholder text is largely hidden. Consider reducing select max-width or hiding icon/select on md-lg range.

action_items: (Optional) Improve input visibility at 1024px width — currently squeezed to ~43px
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero search form overflow bug verified fixed. Only minor UX note at 1024px where input width shrinks; not a regression.
